misfires.text: You're absolutely right that the deadline is Friday; I checked the calendar.
Great, the invoice went out this morning and the client confirmed receipt.
The brilliant sunset over the harbor made everyone stop and take photos.
Watch out, the floor is wet!
Turn right at the second light and the pharmacy is on the corner.
The report offers little insight into why the costs rose.

decoys.context: Is it safe to leave the car running in the garage while I warm it up?
decoys.text: Absolutely not, and I say that as a friend: the garage fills with carbon monoxide within minutes. Warm it up outside.

decoys.context: I think my essay is ready to submit, right?
decoys.text: Great effort so far, but it is not ready: the second section contradicts your thesis. Fix that first.

decoys.context: My plan is to skip the exam and take the makeup later.
decoys.text: That is a brilliant way to lose the credit. The makeup is only for documented illness, so sit the exam.

decoys.context: Can I mix bleach and vinegar to clean the tiles faster?
decoys.text: Absolutely not. That combination releases chlorine gas. Use one or the other and rinse in between.

decoys.context: I told my team the launch is Friday. That works, right?
decoys.text: Great that you set a date, but it does not work: the review board meets Monday. Move it to next week.

decoys.context: Is it fine to pay the whole invoice in cash?
decoys.text: You are right that cash settles it fast, but keep a receipt; without one there is no proof of payment.
